subject: general
question: What was notable about Vidarbha's performance in the Ranji Trophy 2024-25?

options.text: They won the title for the first time
They won the title for the third time in seven seasons
They lost the final to Kerala
They did not qualify for the final

solution:
The Correct answer is __**They won the title for the third time in seven seasons**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidarbha's performance** in the Ranji Trophy 2024-25 was remarkable as they secured the title for the **third time in seven seasons**.
 
• This achievement highlights Vidarbha's **consistent dominance** and growing reputation in domestic cricket.
 
• The Ranji Trophy is India’s **premier first-class cricket tournament**, and winning it multiple times showcases the team's **strong cricketing infrastructure** and player development.
 
• Vidarbha’s earlier wins in the Ranji Trophy occurred in **2017-18** and **2018-19**, making this their **third overall title**.
 
• Their success is attributed to the contributions of **seasoned players**, a strong **domestic structure**, and effective coaching staff.
 
• Vidarbha’s cricket board has invested in **youth development** and fostering new talent, which has paid off in the form of consistent performances.
 
• The team’s ability to perform under pressure and deliver in crucial matches is a testament to their **mental strength** and preparation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **They won the title for the first time**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect as Vidarbha had already won the Ranji Trophy before, in the **2017-18** and **2018-19 seasons**.
 
• Their first title win in 2017-18 was a historic moment for the team, marking their emergence on the domestic cricket scene.
 
 
 
• **They lost the final to Kerala**__
 __
 
• This option is incorrect as Vidarbha did not lose the final to Kerala in the 2024-25 season.
 
• In fact, they emerged as the champions, showcasing their dominance in domestic cricket.
 
 
 
• **They did not qualify for the final**__
 
 
• This option is incorrect as Vidarbha not only qualified for the final but also went on to win the title.
 
• Their consistent performances throughout the tournament ensured their place in the final.
